cards.need: I want to melt down the same kind of untraceable weapons we used in the war to build a memorial.
cards.stakes: It's the only way I can lay the ghosts of my old squad to rest.
cards.board_text: We did terrible things out there with guns that didn't exist on paper. I'm trying to build a monument for the ones who didn't come back, forged from the very metal that tore us apart. Bring me a weapon crate with burned serials. I need to turn something ugly into something peaceful.
